Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.

analyst.text: Victor Wembanyama is coming off a 50-and-19 night against New Orleans and San Antonio have won two straight since their 12-game streak ended, though Dylan Harper is out. Sacramento finally got their first home win, by a point over Boston, with rookie Darius Acuff Jr. scoring 21, but Domantas Sabonis's reported wish to leave and the Zach LaVine trade talk keep the mood fragile. The angle leans towards San Antonio, with De'Aaron Fox facing his former team.
